name: Danish Fewest Moves Championship 2024
information:
Dette er danmarksmesterskabet i 3x3 i Færrest Træk. Der er lokaler man kan vælge at deltage i. Tilmelding og lokaler kan ses [her](https://fm.danskspeedcubingforening.dk/competitions/DanishFMChampionship2024).

------
This is he Danish championship in 3x3 Fewest moves. There are two venues you can compete in. Registration and venues can be seen [here](https://fm.danskspeedcubingforening.dk/competitions/DanishFMChampionship2024).
